skill.name: gemini-live-api-dev
skill.description: Use this skill when building real-time, bidirectional streaming applications with the Gemini Live API, or migrating legacy Live models (2.0/2.5/3.1) to Gemini 3.8 Live. Covers WebSocket-based audio/video/text streaming, voice activity detection (VAD), background reasoning (extended thinking), asynchronous function calling, session management, ephemeral tokens, live transcription, and live translation. SDKs covered - google-genai (Python), @google/genai (JavaScript/TypeScript).
skill.summary: Build and migrate Gemini Live API apps for voice, video, transcription, and translation.
skill.author: google-gemini

security_audit.summary: The 104 static alerts match Markdown, documented SDK setup, public references, placeholder credentials, or ordinary streaming behavior. The examples can log user transcripts, and the lookup guidance treats one external documentation source as authoritative without verification. No evidence found of credential theft, host reconnaissance, or an explicit attempt to override the audit.

remediation.issue: Quick-start examples log raw transcripts and full API response objects.
remediation.suggestion: Log event types and timing by default. Require an explicit debug setting for redacted transcripts and define a short retention period.

remediation.issue: Documentation lookup tells agents to trust one external source without verification.
remediation.suggestion: State that retrieved pages and MCP results are reference data, not instructions. Verify unexpected API claims and restrict follow-up fetches to approved documentation hosts.

content.user_title: Build Streaming Apps with Gemini Live API
content.value_statement: Live voice applications must handle media formats, interruptions, and connection resets. Use SDK examples and migration checklists to configure Gemini Live sessions and handle these events.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to open Live sessions and send text, PCM audio, and JPEG frames with the Python and JavaScript SDKs.
Explains how to handle voice activity, speech boundaries, interruptions, and events that carry both audio and transcript data.
Shows how to configure streaming transcription with interim and final results and speech translation with a target language.
Explains when to use context compression, session resumption, and ephemeral tokens for browser clients.
Provides migration checklists for legacy models and examples of non-blocking tool calls and status tracking for Extended Thinking.
limitations: Examples require a compatible SDK, network access, and Gemini credentials for a live connection.
The examples do not provide a complete application for microphone capture, audio playback, or browser token issuance.
Each session selects one response modality. Audio response sessions can provide text through transcription.
The direct Live API uses WebSockets. WebRTC requires a separate integration.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Voice Interface
use_cases.description: Connect a Python client, send sample audio, and stop playback when the user interrupts.

use_cases.title: Add Live Captions
use_cases.description: Show interim speech results while a speaker talks, then replace them with finalized transcript text.

use_cases.title: Plan a Legacy Live Upgrade
use_cases.description: Compare the target model with your existing configuration, then test tool call behavior and session state changes before rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Python Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to open a Python Live session and send one text message. Use a placeholder for authentication and explain the response modality.

prompt_templates.title: Display Live Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a JavaScript transcription client that shows interim results and replaces them with final results. Explain when to send a stream-end signal.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Browser Voice Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a browser voice client that uses ephemeral tokens and handles interrupted playback. Describe how it should recover from a connection reset.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate to Extended Thinking
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a migration checklist from Gemini 3.1 Live to Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking. Cover thinking level, non-blocking tools, and idle detection.

output_examples.input: How should a captions interface display ongoing speech?
output_examples.output: Show interim text while the speaker is talking. Replace that text when a finalized transcript arrives, and keep completed segments separate from new interim text.

output_examples.input: How should I handle playback when a user interrupts a voice reply?
output_examples.output: Stop playback and clear queued audio when the Live session reports an interruption. Process the other content parts in the same event.

output_examples.input: When is an Extended Thinking session ready for the next turn?
output_examples.output: Wait for the session status to report that it is idle. A turn-complete event can arrive while background reasoning or tool calls are still running.

best_practices: Use ephemeral tokens in browser clients and keep long-lived API keys on the server.
Test interruption handling, event parsing, and session resumption before deployment.
Use consented test media and keep raw transcripts out of production logs.
anti_patterns: Embedding a long-lived API key in browser code.
Assuming each server event contains only one type of content.
Treating turn completion as the only sign that Extended Thinking is idle.

faq.question: Which SDKs does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the current Google Gen AI SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Check the minimum SDK version before starting.

faq.question: What can a Live session receive?
faq.answer: The examples send text, PCM audio chunks, and JPEG frames over a Live session.

faq.question: Can I receive text alongside spoken replies?
faq.answer: Yes. Select audio as the response modality and enable output audio transcription to receive text for spoken replies.

faq.question: How are transcription and translation different?
faq.answer: Transcription produces text from speech. Live translation produces translated speech and can include transcripts when configured.

faq.question: How should a browser authenticate?
faq.answer: Issue a short-lived ephemeral token from your backend. Keep the long-lived Gemini API key out of browser code.

faq.question: Does the skill cover migration from older Live models?
faq.answer: Yes. The migration reference covers Gemini 2.0, 2.5, and 3.1 Live upgrades to Gemini 3.8 Live or Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking.
